basic_details.job_title: PAU Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) Project Associate-I Notification 2026 has been released on 22 July 2026 on the official website https://www.pau.edu/. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the PAU Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: B.Sc./B.Tech. Biotechnology/Agriculture/B.Sc. Biosciences, M.Sc. in Biotechnology/Molecular Biology/Plant Breeding/Plant Breeding & Genetics/Genetics/crop plants/Biochemistry/Microbiology, NET/NET-LS/GATE/other National level tests
qualification.details: I. B.Sc./B.Tech. Biotechnology/Agriculture/B.Sc. Biosciences with minimum OGPA 6.00/10.00 basis or 60 % marks. II. how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.pau.edu.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Project Associate-I post at Punjab Agricultural University is August 3, 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate-I position will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 31,000 per month, along with an additional 16% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Sc./B.Tech. in Biotechnology/Agriculture/Biosciences with at least 60% marks or an M.Sc. in relevant fields like Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, or Plant Breeding with at least 65% marks. NET/GATE qualification is also required.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it carefully, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the PAU Project Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 200/-. This fee needs to be submitted along with the application form as per the instructions in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. When is the interview scheduled for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Project Associate-I position is scheduled to be held on August 12, 2026. Candidates are advised to be prepared for the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age limit for the Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I position. For detailed information on age relaxation, please refer to the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-I post in the Punjab Agricultural University recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Associate-I position is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the project.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, www.pau.edu. Direct links are also provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
